physicalNotes: Radius 2.18 +/- 0.29 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,516,626 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 2.78 +/- 1.28 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6250 +/- 100 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-72 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
